panels.title: Disk Usage %
panels.description: cloudberry_disk_usage_percent{cluster,namespace} (Scenario 116 / S.1+M.1+R.2). Measured each reconcile by reconcileStorage->recordDiskUsage when diskMonitoring=true: prefers true filesystem usage via gp_toolkit.gp_disk_free, falling back to a logical-size-vs-provisioned-capacity proxy (sum(pg_database_size) / segment PVC capacity) when gp_disk_free is unavailable. The gauge is published from the same value written to status.diskUsagePercent (M.1 == S.1) and tracks growth as data is loaded.

panels.title: Config Reloads
panels.description: Configuration reloads in the last hour, per deployed cluster. Shows 0 (not 'No data') for a deployed cluster that has not reloaded yet.

panels.title: Auth Attempts (1h)

targets.expr: (sum by (namespace) (increase(cloudberry_auth_attempts_total{instance=~"$instance"}[1h])) * on(namespace) group_right () (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0 + 1)) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.description: Authentication attempts in the last hour, attributed per deployed cluster (operator-global metric joined by namespace). Shows 0 (not "No data") for a deployed cluster with no auth attempts yet.

panels.description: Rate of admission webhook DENIED decisions from cloudberry_webhook_admission_total{webhook,operation,result="denied"}. The validating webhook enforces the data-loading rules W.1–W.25 (Scenario 110: pxf.image required, server name/type/config, job name/type, pxfJob server/profile/targetTable, gpload targetTable, cron schedule, partitioning, segmentRejectLimitType) plus the storage-recommendation rules W.1–W.4 (Scenario 113: storage.recommendationScan.bloatThreshold/skewThreshold/indexBloatThreshold must be 0–100 and ageThreshold must be non-negative — enabled-gated, webhook-authoritative) plus cluster-uniqueness/mirroring. Each rejected CR is denied with a descriptive error and does NOT persist. W.3/W.8/W.15 (data-loading) are additionally guarded by CRD OpenAPI enums.

panels.description: Rate of PXF restart operations triggered via cloudberry-ctl pxf restart / POST data-loading/pxf/restart, from cloudberry_pxf_restart_total{cluster,namespace,result}. result=started on a successful StatefulSet restart-trigger bump (rolls the segment pods and their PXF sidecars), result=failed otherwise. Counts operator-issued restarts, NOT in-place sidecar restarts.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, result) (rate(cloudberry_pxf_restart_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[5m])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: PXF Server Config Changes
panels.description: Rate of PXF server-configuration changes from cloudberry_pxf_servers_changed_total{cluster,namespace}. The operator increments this counter ONLY when the <cluster>-pxf-servers ConfigMap Data actually changes (a server in dataLoading.pxf.servers[] was added, updated, or removed) — Scenario 106 (SL.7 update / SL.8 delete). Never incremented on a no-op reconcile. A corresponding Kubernetes Event 'PXFServersChanged' (added=[..] removed=[..] updated=[..]) is emitted on the controller reconcile path.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_pxf_servers_changed_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[5m])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Data Loading Rows by Source Type
panels.description: Rows-loaded rate aggregated purely by the real source_type label of cloudberry_data_loading_rows_total (s3/hdfs/hive/jdbc/gpfdist/file). Highlights object-store (s3) loads (Scenario 96). source_type is derived from the data-loading Job's server/source type; the value is harvested from the Job pod's DATALOAD_ROWS termination marker (never synthesized).

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, source_type) (rate(cloudberry_data_loading_rows_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[5m])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Hadoop Data Loading Rows (HDFS/Hive/HBase)
panels.description: Rows-loaded rate filtered to Hadoop source types (hdfs, hive, hbase) from cloudberry_data_loading_rows_total{source_type=~"hdfs|hive|hbase"}. Scenario 97 Hadoop Profiles: source_type is derived from the data-loading Job's PXF server type; the value is harvested from the Job pod's DATALOAD_ROWS termination marker (never synthesized).

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, source_type) (rate(cloudberry_data_loading_rows_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",source_type=~"hdfs|hive|hbase"}[5m])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Data Loading Job Failures (kube-state-metrics)
panels.description: Failed data-loading Kubernetes Jobs from kube-state-metrics (kube_job_status_failed). Filters to jobs matching *-dataload-* naming convention. A spike indicates a health-check init failure (Scenario 104) or a load execution failure. This is a genuinely NEW panel enabled by kube-state-metrics deployment.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_failed{instance=~"$instance",job_name=~".*-dataload-.*"}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: gpfdist Deployment Ready Replicas (kube-state-metrics)

targets.expr: max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{instance=~"$instance",deployment=~".*-gpfdist"}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

Derived from real segment-primary pxf container readiness (Scenario 109 M.1). Kill a segment's pxf -> that host -> 0.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, pod) (cloudberry_pxf_service_up{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

Honest: ABSENT for jobs where no real byte count is available (external/pxf/FDW) — never synthesized (Scenario 109 M.10).

NOTE: server/profile/operation labels are not actuator-derivable; count+latency are the honest signals (request labels downgraded to actuator-native uri/method/status).

max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_data_skew_coefficient{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Recommendations by Type
panels.description: cloudberry_recommendations_total{type} (Scenario 117 / M.2). recordRecommendations runs all four threshold-aware scans each reconcile when recommendationScan is enabled and publishes a gauge per type: bloat (RT.1/C.6, dead_pct>=bloatThreshold), skew (RT.2/C.7, skew coeff>=skewThreshold), age (RT.3/C.8, age(relfrozenxid)>=ageThreshold), index_bloat (RT.4/C.9, bloat_pct>=indexBloatThreshold). All four types are published (including 0 when a type clears), and the sum equals status.recommendationCount (S.2/R.4 — the M.2==count invariant). table_bloat_ratio reflects the bloat ratio for the top tables (M.4).

panels.title: Recommendation Scan Duration
panels.description: cloudberry_recommendation_scan_duration_seconds histogram (Scenario 118 / M.3): the operator observes the elapsed time of each recommendation scan in recordRecommendations. The scan is capped at spec.storage.recommendationScan.scanDuration (C.10, resolveScanDuration: default 10s, clamp 24h, else verbatim) applied to the four Get* queries (the DB connection has a separate fixed budget). When a scan hits the cap it records partial results and increments cloudberry_recommendation_scan_truncated_total (the 'truncated/s' series here) and sets status.recommendationScanTruncated; the duration metric reflects the capped run.

panels.title: Recommendation Scan CronJob (Scenario 115 / C.5)
panels.description: cloudberry_recommendation_scan_cronjob gauge per cluster: 1 when the operator's reconcileStorage (R.1 diskMonitoring gate) has ensured the <cluster>-recommendation-scan CronJob (C.5) for the recommendationScan.schedule, 0 when GC'd (disabled). Pairs with the StorageConfigured=True condition (R.5).

targets.expr: (sum by (namespace) (increase(cloudberry_active_query_export_total{instance=~"$instance"}[24h])) * on(namespace) group_right () (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0 + 1)) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Storage API Requests (P.1–P.6)

Covers Scenario 119 endpoints: P.1 GET disk-usage (diskUsagePercent==status + per-segment breakdown), P.2 GET tables (size/bloat/skew via GetTables), P.3 GET tables/{schema}/{table} (detail + indexSizes), P.4 GET recommendations (type+target), P.5 POST recommendations/scan (202 enabled / 400 RECOMMENDATION_SCAN_NOT_ENABLED), P.6 GET usage-report (usageReportEnabled gate). panels.title: gpfdist Reconciles (1h)
panels.description: Total gpfdist resource reconcile outcomes in the last hour from cloudberry_gpfdist_reconcile_total

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_gpfdist_reconcile_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: gpfdist Errors (1h)
panels.description: Total gpfdist reconcile errors in the last hour from cloudberry_gpfdist_reconcile_total{result='error'}

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_gpfdist_reconcile_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",result="error"}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: PXF Extension Setup Rate by Result
panels.description: Rate of PXF client-extension setup attempt outcomes from cloudberry_pxf_extension_setup_total{cluster,namespace,result}. result is one of {installed, absent, error}: installed when extensions were created, absent when DB reachable but none installed, error on hard failure.

panels.title: PXF Extension Setups (1h)
panels.description: Total PXF extension setup attempts in the last hour from cloudberry_pxf_extension_setup_total

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_pxf_extension_setup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: PXF Extension Errors (1h)
panels.description: Total PXF extension setup errors in the last hour from cloudberry_pxf_extension_setup_total{result='error'}

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_pxf_extension_setup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",result="error"}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Data-Loader Role Setup Rate by Result
panels.description: Rate of data-loader role setup attempt outcomes from cloudberry_dataloader_role_setup_total{cluster,namespace,result}. result is one of {success, error}: success when the dedicated data-loader login role was ensured/granted, error on a hard connectivity/setup failure.

panels.title: Data-Loader Role Setups (1h)
panels.description: Total data-loader role setup attempts in the last hour from cloudberry_dataloader_role_setup_total

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_dataloader_role_setup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Data-Loader Role Errors (1h)
panels.description: Total data-loader role setup errors in the last hour from cloudberry_dataloader_role_setup_total{result='error'}

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_dataloader_role_setup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",result="error"}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Exporter Role Setup Rate by Result
panels.description: Rate of metrics-exporter role setup attempt outcomes from cloudberry_exporter_role_setup_total{cluster,namespace,result}. result is one of {success, error}: success when the metrics-exporter DB login role was created/granted, error on a hard connectivity/setup failure.

panels.title: Exporter Role Setups (1h)
panels.description: Total metrics-exporter role setup attempts in the last hour from cloudberry_exporter_role_setup_total

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_exporter_role_setup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Exporter Role Errors (1h)
panels.description: Total metrics-exporter role setup errors in the last hour from cloudberry_exporter_role_setup_total{result='error'}

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_exporter_role_setup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",result="error"}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: FTS Probe Failures (1h)
panels.description: FTS Probe Failures (1h) per deployed cluster. Shows 0 (not "No data") for a deployed cluster with none yet.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_fts_probe_failures_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: FTS Failovers (1h)
panels.description: FTS Failovers (1h) per deployed cluster. Shows 0 (not "No data") for a deployed cluster with none yet.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_fts_failover_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Backup Job Status Over Time
panels.description: Per-Job backup status timeline (cloudberry_backup_job_status, operation=backup). Codes: 0=Pending, 1=Running, 2=Succeeded, 3=Failed. A drop to 3 marks a Scenario 77 pre-backup-check block or a failed backup run.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, operation) (cloudberry_backup_job_status{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",operation="backup"}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Backup Outcomes Rate (success vs failed)
panels.description: Rate of backup outcomes by result (cloudberry_backup_total). Rising failed series indicates recurring Scenario 77 pre-backup-check blocks.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, type, result) (rate(cloudberry_backup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[5m])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Restore Validation Outcomes (success vs failed)
panels.description: Post-restore validation outcomes over time by result (cloudberry_restore_validation_total{result}). Scenario 80: the failed series rises when validation flags a row-count mismatch vs gpbackup history, an invalid index, or a failed health-check query.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, result) (increase(cloudberry_restore_validation_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Restore/Migration Outcomes Rate (success vs failed)
panels.description: Rate of restore outcomes by result (cloudberry_restore_total{result}). Scenario 87 cross-cluster migration runs gprestore on the target as a restore; a rising failed series indicates the migration restore step is failing.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, result) (rate(cloudberry_restore_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[5m])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Restore Duration p95 (Migration)
panels.description: 95th percentile restore (gprestore) duration from cloudberry_restore_duration_seconds_bucket. Tracks how long the Scenario 87 migration restore step takes on the target cluster.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, le) (rate(cloudberry_restore_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[5m]))) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Failed Backup Jobs
panels.description: Number of backup Jobs currently in the Failed state (cloudberry_backup_job_status == 3, operation=backup). A non-zero value indicates a Scenario 77 pre-backup-check block or a failed backup execution.

targets.expr: count by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_backup_job_status{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",operation="backup"} == 3) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Backups Failed (1h)
panels.description: Backup operations that failed in the last hour (cloudberry_backup_total{result="failed"}). Each Scenario 77 pre-backup-check block increments this counter.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_backup_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",result="failed"}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Restore Validation (1h)
panels.description: Post-restore validation outcomes by result in the last hour (cloudberry_restore_validation_total{result=success|failed}). Scenario 80 records this from the validation Job's terminal status.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_restore_validation_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Restore Validations Failed (1h)
panels.description: Post-restore validation failures in the last hour (cloudberry_restore_validation_total{result="failed"}). Scenario 80: a non-zero value means the validation Job flagged an issue (e.g. row-count mismatch vs gpbackup history, invalid index, or failed health check).

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace) (increase(cloudberry_restore_validation_total{instance=~"$instance",cluster!="",result="failed"}[1h])) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Webhook Denied (1h)
panels.description: Webhook admissions denied in the last hour, per deployed cluster (operator-global metric joined by namespace).

targets.expr: (sum by (namespace) (increase(cloudberry_webhook_admission_total{instance=~"$instance",result="denied"}[1h])) * on(namespace) group_right () (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0 + 1)) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: Webhook Errors (1h)
panels.description: Webhook admission errors in the last hour, per deployed cluster (operator-global metric joined by namespace).

targets.expr: (sum by (namespace) (increase(cloudberry_webhook_admission_total{instance=~"$instance",result="error"}[1h])) * on(namespace) group_right () (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0 + 1)) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.description: Number of external PXF servers declared in the spec (len(pxf.servers)), set by reconcileDataLoading when pxf.enabled. Config-derived, NOT a liveness/health signal.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_pxf_servers_configured{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: PXF Servers Configured
Data Loading Last Success
panels.description: Time since the last successful data loading Job run per job, derived from cloudberry_data_loading_job_last_success_timestamp (Unix seconds).

targets.expr: (time() - max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_data_loading_job_last_success_timestamp{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""})) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.description: Number of PXF client extensions (pxf, pxf_fdw) observed in pg_extension via live probe. ABSENT when the DB is unreachable or no PXF extensions are installed. From cloudberry_pxf_extensions_installed{cluster,namespace}.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_pxf_extensions_installed{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)

panels.title: PXF Extensions Installed

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_redistribution_progress{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)
max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_data_skew_coefficient{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) or (max by (cluster, namespace) (cloudberry_cluster_info{instance=~"$instance",cluster!=""}) * 0)
